2026-10-10  flow/generated_tile_replay.sh  (bench: sim/tb_logic_tile_bitstream.v -DGEN_TILE; base 8ecb005)
  LABEL : EXPERIMENTAL single generated LOGIC4 tile on the G1 harness (same-index matrix, CAP
          loopbacks, pad overlay). No serial configuration loader, no timing, no inter-tile and
          no ratified-fabric claim (ADR-0004/0005 Proposed).
  DUT   : FABulous-generated Tile/LOGIC4/LOGIC4.v composing LOGIC4_ConfigMem + LOGIC4_switch_matrix
          + 4x lut4_ff_bel (+ Fabric/models_pack.v), unmodified, in gitignored flow/build/fabulous-run/.
          sha256 LOGIC4.v               = f285e4b9f9326a8671ffdb5e18898b17c10b363411a51c4ac776cb1b53cfecce
          sha256 LOGIC4_ConfigMem.v     = dcdfc776e732e5ed0043014bd4a4aefab0981baec9ea0f0d9a767df42a2e2686
          sha256 LOGIC4_switch_matrix.v = 4a8c1f3f2da8292b73f0808eee6cd65dc3992428df978b5b3af98a184de0202b
          sha256 lut4_ff_bel.v          = 8ae0889ced0347a9e0ec271c12e8cd95518b40b6faa9753efaee05c59581aeeb
          sha256 models_pack.v          = 0bb111e18e1941b5c21d528ef60d2e3195ed311b99f59c35c9f2fc8543344a09
  Boundary: N/E/S/W1END[3:0] in, N/E/S/W1BEG[3:0] out, UserCLK, FrameData[31:0], FrameStrobe[19:0]
          (UserCLKo / FrameData_O / FrameStrobe_O connected, not checked). Header port set and the
          ConfigMem/matrix/4-BEL composition are checked before compiling.
  Method: each frame addressed to the logic tile written in stream order through FrameData/
          FrameStrobe (20 legal frame writes per stream; map not used to load); internal ConfigBits
          read back == recorded .cfg == python decoder; same independent oracles, CAP loopbacks
          and pad interpretation as the #74 harness, +mutate perturbations rewritten as frames.
          Every fixture also run on design/rtl/logic_tile_routed.v; both PASS with identical
          check/perturbation counts.
  Result: generated-tile replay: 16/16 fixtures PASS on the generated LOGIC4 and the repository composition
    top_io           [comb]     5409 checks, 0 failures; 26/26 perturbations detected (0 loopbacks)
    top_reg          [reg]    139651 checks, 0 failures; 27/27 perturbations detected (2 loopbacks)
    quad4_s1..s3     [quad4]   83201 checks, 0 failures; 52/52 perturbations detected (each)
    casc2_s1..s3     [casc2]   10049 checks, 0 failures; 24/24 perturbations detected (each, 1 loopback)
    casc_fan_s1..s3  [casc_fan] 64705 checks, 0 failures; 54/54 perturbations detected (each, 3 loopbacks)
    regcasc_s1,s3    [regcasc] 313273 checks, 0 failures; 36/36 perturbations detected (each, 3 loopbacks)
    fan4_distinct_s1..s3 [fan4] 61697 checks, 0 failures; 38/38 perturbations detected (each)
  Composition mutations (scratch LOGIC4.v copies; each compiled, ConfigBits readback still == recorded):
    belcfg : BEL A <-> BEL B ConfigBits slices swapped -> functional FAIL on 15/16 fixtures
             (unaffected: casc2_s3, which places on BELs C/D), e.g.
             top_io[comb] 16 failures / 257 checks; top_reg[reg] 2397 / 6385; regcasc_s1 3371 / 10945
    ensr_A : BEL A EN/SR swapped -> functional FAIL on 1/16: top_reg[reg] 3326 failures / 6385 checks
    ensr_B : BEL B EN/SR swapped -> functional FAIL on 2/16: regcasc_s1, regcasc_s3 [regcasc]
             5969 failures / 10945 checks each
    (EN/SR defects are only observable on a BEL whose flop a fixture uses: top_reg = BEL A,
     regcasc = BEL B; other fixtures PASS, which the script accepts as long as >= 1 oracle fails
     and no run is an infrastructure failure.)
  Finding during bring-up (simulation-only, recorded for reviewers):
    - The generated sources have no `timescale and the matrix uses FABulous placeholder
      `assign #80` delays; compiled first they defaulted to 1 s units and every output was X.
      They are now compiled under `timescale 1ps/1ps (80 ps per mux). Not a timing model.
    - Configuring the live tile frame by frame let the X ConfigBits of the first writes push an
      X into a CAP loopback of a don't-care cycle; casc_fan_s3 then failed every baseline check
      (1536/1537) on the generated tile while the repository composition (cfg valid from t=0)
      passed. The bench now forces the loopbacks to 0 once after configuration, the same
      flush_loops mechanism used between perturbations; the belcfg mutant still fails
      casc_fan_s3 (506 failures) with it in place.

  Extends the #140 replay to registered control wiring on every BEL. Four new fixtures

    regbel_a_s1  131671 checks, 0 failures; 20/20 perturbations detected (1 loopback)
    regbel_b_s1, regbel_c_s1, regbel_d_s1  113851 checks, 0 failures; 17/17 perturbations detected (each)
    (all 4 control oracles: capture, hold, sync reset with enable low, reset priority with enable high)
  Composition mutations (5/5 caught; each compiled; ConfigBits readback == recorded on all fixtures):
    belcfg : functional FAIL on 17/20 fixtures
    ensr_A : 2/20 -- top_reg[reg], regbel_a_s1 (7921 checks, 5382 failures)
    ensr_B : 3/20 -- regcasc_s1, regcasc_s3, regbel_b_s1 (5382 failures / 7921 checks)
    ensr_C : 1/20 -- regbel_c_s1 (5382 failures / 7921 checks)   [new]
    ensr_D : 1/20 -- regbel_d_s1 (5382 failures / 7921 checks)   [new]
    The script now additionally requires each ensr_X to FAIL on its matching regbel_x_s1 fixture, so a
    swap that compiles but is not sensitized on that BEL fails the run. No infrastructure failures.
  Not covered: ratified fabric (ADR-0004/0005 remain Proposed), inter-tile routing, timing, the real

  LUT basis diagnostic: every truth-table address of every LUT4 BEL through the integrated tile.
  Scope: 73 DIAGNOSTIC streams assembled by flow/lut_basis.py through the existing assembler

    Cases, loaded in this order into ONE live tile with no reset between them: blank; then per BEL A..D
    all-ones, one-hot INIT for addresses 0..15, all-zero. FF (reg_sel) never set (combinational).
  Routes (one shared set, 36 pips, each present in the frozen pip model; wiring traced from the FASM):
    CAP_N pad i -> S1BEG<i> -> LOGIC4 S1END<i> -> L{A,B,C,D}_I<i> (i = 0..3; the matrix offers each
    LUT input I<i> exactly N/E/S/W1END<i>); L{A,B,C,D}_O -> S1BEG{0,1,2,3} -> CAP_S pads A..D. No loopbacks.
  DUT: same generated files as the #140 record (sha256 LOGIC4.v f285e4b9..., LOGIC4_ConfigMem.v
    dcdfc776..., LOGIC4_switch_matrix.v 4a8c1f3f..., lut4_ff_bel.v 8ae0889c..., models_pack.v 0bb111e1...),

    1460 frame writes); and design/rtl/logic_tile_routed.v through its cfg port. Bench sim/tb_lut_basis.v.
  Oracle (from the case identifier only; cfg/map/ConfigBits never used for an expected value):
    selected BEL output == (input vector == address) for one-hot, == 1 for all-ones; the other three
    BEL outputs == 0; all 16 vectors x 6 values on the unrouted input tracks (0000, FFFF, AAAA, 5555,
    2 random) x 4 BEL outputs per case. Verdicts classified by flow/gate_sim_verdict.sh under the
    SIM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS budget.
  Result: LUT basis PASS on both compositions (28032 checks, 0 failures; 73/73 cases), identical summaries.
    COVERAGE: BEL A: 16/16 addresses, BEL B: 16/16, BEL C: 16/16, BEL D: 16/16
              (each one-hot case: all 16 input vectors x 6 unrouted-track values x 4 BEL outputs)
    COVERAGE: 4 BELs x 16 addresses = 64/64 one-hot cases; 4 all-ones, 5 all-zero cases; 73 cases
              loaded in sequence into one live tile -- on the generated LOGIC4 and on the repository composition.
    Per-case readback (generated ConfigBits / repository cfg) == python decode of the stream, 73/73 on both.
  Scratch mutants (each compiled; completed functional FAIL; failing case set == the set predicted from
    the defect; readback still == decoded on every case, so storage checks cannot see them):
    lutin_C : LUT-input permutation, BEL C I0 <-> I1 in a scratch LOGIC4.v
              96 failures / 28032 checks; 8/73 cases: C_a01 C_a02 C_a05 C_a06 C_a09 C_a10 C_a13 C_a14
    init56  : generated-BEL INIT-bit swap, LUT entries 5 <-> 6 in a scratch lut4_ff_bel.v (all BELs)
              96 failures / 28032 checks; 8/73 cases: {A,B,C,D}_a05, {A,B,C,D}_a06
    belcfg  : BEL A <-> BEL B ConfigBits slices swapped (the step-4 scratch LOGIC4.v)
              768 failures / 28032 checks; 34/73 cases: every A and B one-hot and all-ones case

2026-10-10  flow/generated_tile_replay.sh step 9  (issue #188; bench: sim/tb_boundary_fwd.v -DGEN_TILE; base 6a54e8c)
  LABEL : EXPERIMENTAL single generated LOGIC4 tile; logical forwarding only. No timing, no inter-tile, no ratified-fabric claim
          (ADR-0004/0005/0006 Proposed). Generated-tile only: the repository composition has no pass-through ports.
  DUT   : unmodified FABulous-generated LOGIC4.v, sha256 = f285e4b9f9326a8671ffdb5e18898b17c10b363411a51c4ac776cb1b53cfecce
  Contract (verified assignment by assignment by the script from the pinned LOGIC4.v): UserCLKo = UserCLK (clk_buf);
    FrameData_O[i] = FrameData[i] x32 and FrameStrobe_O[i] = FrameStrobe[i] x20 (my_buf chains). Pure logical copies; delays are not
    modelled or claimed.
  Oracle: the bench's own driven inputs, four-state (!==) compare; ConfigBits/cfg/map never read.
  Stimulus: clock both levels, repeated edges; walking one/zero over 32 data bits and 20 strobe bits; idle strobes with changing data;
    legal one-hot frame writes for all 20 frames (x2) with the clock toggling.
  Result: PASS (1554 checks, 0 failures); COVERAGE: UserCLKo 106 rising and 106 falling edges followed (only real clock level changes
    are counted); FrameData_O 32/32 bits and FrameStrobe_O 20/20 bits forwarded at both levels; PORTFAIL: UserCLKo=0 FrameData_O=0
    FrameStrobe_O=0 (required all zero).
  Scratch generated-tile mutants (compiled; completed functional FAIL; attribution from the bench's unconditional per-port failure
    counters (PORTFAIL line, every failure counted, not only the printed mismatch lines): mutated port >0, the other two exactly 0):
    clk_open    : UserCLKo output left unconnected         518 failures / 1554 checks; PORTFAIL UserCLKo=518 FrameData_O=0   FrameStrobe_O=0
    clk_inv     : UserCLKo driven from the inverted clock  518 failures / 1554 checks; PORTFAIL UserCLKo=518 FrameData_O=0   FrameStrobe_O=0
    data_alias  : FrameData_O[9] aliased to FrameData_O[8] 203 failures / 1554 checks; PORTFAIL UserCLKo=0   FrameData_O=203 FrameStrobe_O=0
    strobe_drop : FrameStrobe_O[13] tied low                43 failures / 1554 checks; PORTFAIL UserCLKo=0   FrameData_O=0   FrameStrobe_O=43
  Attribution check of the check (manual, not part of the script): a two-fault scratch tile (clock inverted AND FrameData_O[9] aliased to
    bit 8) gives FUNC_FAIL with 721 failures and PORTFAIL UserCLKo=518 FrameData_O=203 FrameStrobe_O=0, so it is rejected as a
    UserCLKo-only mutant; its first 20 printed mismatch lines are all UserCLKo, which the earlier printed-line attribution would have accepted.
  Unchanged in the same run: all earlier steps PASS (20/20 fixtures, 5/5 composition mutations, LUT basis, LUT-input, control-jump and
    output-track diagnostics with their mutants). Final line: generated-tile replay: PASS (... tile forwarding UserCLKo + FrameData_O 32/32
    + FrameStrobe_O 20/20 on the generated tile, 4/4 forwarding mutants caught).
  Not covered (G5 stays OPEN): inter-tile chaining, timing of the forwarding paths, ratified fabric, hardware frame loader.
